final: SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 as region, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count, COUNT(o.order_id) - (SELECT AVG(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id)) as diff_from_avg FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3 ORDER BY diff_from_avg DESC LIMIT 10
